Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture
public final class TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture extends Object
Configures the two independent pipe inventories created by a full-bore rupture.

The rupture plane divides an initially uniform, rigid, constant-area gas pipe into a left and a right inventory. Each inventory is advanced by RealGasPipeDecompression from its remote closed end toward the common rupture plane. The two resulting jets point in opposite axial directions and are therefore retained as separate CoupledReleaseSource equipment and separate source-term frames. Their rates must not be collapsed into one thermodynamic station.

This topology is adiabatic and single-gas. It uses instantaneous full opening by default and can apply one prescribed delayed linear area ramp to both branches. It does not couple pressure across the open rupture plane, model pipe elasticity, infer crack propagation or opening, or add non-equilibrium multiphase transport. The caller owns native ProcessSystem or process-model execution and can sum the exposed branch inventories for whole-pipe mass and energy accounting.

  • Constructor Details

    • TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture

      public TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture(String name, SystemInterface initialGas, double totalLengthM, double ruptureDistanceFromLeftM, double diameterM, double dischargeCoefficient, double backPressurePa, double darcyFrictionFactor, int totalCells, double cfl)
      Creates an adiabatic two-sided real-gas rupture topology.
      Parameters:
      name - stable topology name used to derive equipment and source identities
      initialGas - initial uniform equilibrium gas and selected EOS
      totalLengthM - total pipe length in m
      ruptureDistanceFromLeftM - rupture distance from the left closed end in m
      diameterM - internal pipe diameter in m
      dischargeCoefficient - effective full-bore area factor in (0,1]
      backPressurePa - constant absolute receiver pressure at the rupture plane in Pa
      darcyFrictionFactor - specified Darcy friction factor in [0,1]
      totalCells - total finite-volume cells shared by the two branches, from 16 through 800
      cfl - Courant number in (0,0.7]
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for an invalid name, rupture position or cell allocation

    • TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture

      public TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture(String name, SystemInterface initialGas, double totalLengthM, double ruptureDistanceFromLeftM, double diameterM, double dischargeCoefficient, double backPressurePa, double darcyFrictionFactor, int totalCells, double cfl, RealGasPipeDecompression.ReleaseOpeningProfile openingProfile)
      Creates a two-sided real-gas rupture with a prescribed finite-opening history.

      Both branches share the same immutable area-fraction profile and evaluate it within their conservative CFL substeps. The profile is a declared boundary sensitivity. It does not infer crack propagation, wall fracture, elastic wave speed or pressure coupling across the open rupture plane.

      Parameters:
      name - stable topology name used to derive equipment and source identities
      initialGas - initial uniform equilibrium gas and selected EOS
      totalLengthM - total pipe length in m
      ruptureDistanceFromLeftM - rupture distance from the left closed end in m
      diameterM - internal pipe diameter in m
      dischargeCoefficient - maximum effective full-bore area factor in (0,1]
      backPressurePa - constant absolute receiver pressure at the rupture plane in Pa
      darcyFrictionFactor - specified Darcy friction factor in [0,1]
      totalCells - total finite-volume cells shared by the two branches, from 16 through 800
      cfl - Courant number in (0,0.7]
      openingProfile - immutable prescribed opening-area history shared by both branches
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the initial gas or opening profile is null
      IllegalArgumentException - for an invalid name, rupture position or cell allocation
